data.title: How a nuclear power plant works

sentences.text: If you stand uranium rods in a tank of water, you have a reactor.
But the water boils, and the steam just escapes.
So you pipe the steam to a turbine that spins a generator.
But now the reaction speeds up, and the rods glow red hot.
So you lower control rods that soak up neutrons and slow it down.
This is a nuclear power plant.
Hot steam spins the turbine, and the generator makes power.
But now used steam piles up, and the turbine stalls.
So a cooling tower turns the steam back into water.
One fuel pellet makes about as much energy as one ton of coal.
Add a thick concrete dome over the reactor.
Congratulations, you have built a nuclear power plant.
